'''Goru''' was a hulking [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was captain of a [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]].

==Biography==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Goru was a part of a team led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] to attack a ship filled with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Younglings]], in order to steal their [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. Goru was knocked unconscious by several of the Younglings during the process.

Later, Goru and fellow captain [[Sabo]] were contacted by [[Jiro/Legends|Jiro]], who wished them to join with him in betraying [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] to [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]]. Goru immediately agreed with Jiro's terms, while Sabo was still uncertain, wishing to contact Ohnaka. Maul killed Sabo in front of a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of Hondo.

Goru fought for Maul in a [[Skirmish on Florrum/Legends|skirmish on the surface of]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. However, midway through the battle, Hondo was able to convince Jiro and Goru to come back to his side. The re-allied pirates chased the two [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] off of the planet.

==Personality and traits==
Goru favored a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] of the same model as [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Rumi Paramita/Legends|Rumi Paramita's]].
